Acrylic stand vs acrylic keychain: what are you buying?

By Kokeniwa · Published 2026-10-21 · Sources checked 2026-10-21

An acrylic stand is intended to stand on a base; an acrylic keychain is intended to hang from hardware. Some products support both uses, but do not assume a stand includes a chain or that a keychain comes with a matching base.

On this pageRecognise the abbreviated Japanese namesA convertible product is a specific designRead the included-parts lineCompare the dimensions that matterChoose by where the item will liveA useful question to send a seller

Recognise the abbreviated Japanese names

Listing termPractical meaning
アクリルスタンド / アクスタAcrylic stand; check the base and assembly parts
アクリルキーホルダー / アクキーAcrylic keychain; check the connector and attachment
台座 / daizaBase
ボールチェーンBall chain
ナスカンClasp-style attachment; examine its actual shape
本体 / 付属品Main item / included accessories

A convertible product is a specific design

ACCEA’s acrylic-stand service offers a base and an optional ball chain, allowing that product design to work as a hanging item too. Its keychain service separately lists attachment options. These are examples of why you should inspect the item configuration rather than infer everything from “acrylic.” They do not establish interchangeability across makers.

Sources: ACCEA: acrylic figures and stands · ACCEA: acrylic keychains

Read the included-parts line

Look for a complete photograph or parts list. Check whether the listing sells one character piece, the base alone, a replacement part or a full set. If several characters appear in an example display, find the quantity stated in the actual offer.

For a stand, the tab on the character piece must match the base slot. A spare base that looks similar in a photograph may have a different slot width or thickness. For a keychain, check that the attachment is included and that there is a usable connection point. Neither use can be established by the front illustration alone.

Compare the dimensions that matter

Your intended useMeasurements to check
Desk or shelf displayAssembled height, base footprint and space around it
Hanging on a bagTotal hanging length, connector opening and nearby items it may touch
Storage in a sleeveLargest flat-piece width and height, plus thickness
Carrying several standsEach piece and base separately; how they will be kept from rubbing

Choose by where the item will live

For a fixed shelf display, the base footprint and stability matter more than whether a chain could be added. For a bag, inspect the hanging arrangement and think about contact with zips or other goods. For travel, consider how the detached base and character piece will be stored. This is a use-case comparison, not a durability ranking.

Keep the product’s care instructions and materials description with the item. Do not assume that a cleaner or storage accessory recommended for another acrylic product is suitable for this one.

A useful question to send a seller

Instead of asking only “Is this an acrysta?”, ask for the exact included parts and assembled dimensions: “Does this item include the base and hanging hardware, and what are the body and base measurements?” That turns an abbreviation into information you can use to make a purchase decision.

Sources & scope

  • ACCEA: acrylic figures and stands
  • ACCEA: acrylic keychains
